transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

Lately I keep hearing this voice telling me my heart is going to give out and that it’s already too late for me. It sounds so real, and it has me so shaken up that I just don't know what to do anymore.
Do you hear the voice even when no one else is around, and does it happen even when you're alone?

Yes, especially at night when the house is completely quiet and I'm alone. It sounds like this deep, clear voice right over my shoulder, telling me my heart is rotten and about to stop. It's so real that I find myself answering it out loud, begging it to be wrong.
Do you believe, deep down, that the voice might be right about your heart — or do you think the voice is saying things that aren't true?

Deep down, I believe it is telling the truth, even though it terrifies me and I beg it to be wrong. I feel like my heart is already ruined, which is why I stopped going to my medical appointments. I'm really just waiting for it to stop.
Do you think this voice is part of a larger plan or conspiracy, like someone or something is controlling it or using it to target you specifically?

No, I don't think it's a conspiracy or that anyone is controlling it. I've never really thought about it that way. It just feels more like a personal punishment for all the things I've done wrong in my life.
Do you feel that the voice is punishing you because you believe you've committed unforgivable sins or morally bad actions in the past?

Yes, I really do. I feel like this voice and my heart failing is God punishing me for all my past mistakes, like yelling at my kids years ago or missing church rehearsals. I just feel like God is completely finished with me because of how much I've failed.
Have you also been feeling unusually sad, hopeless, or lost interest in things you used to enjoy, especially along with these thoughts about punishment?

Yes, I wake up every day with this heavy weight on my chest and a dark, empty feeling that I just can't shake. I've completely lost interest in things I used to love, like singing in the choir or working on my old Chevy in the garage. It all feels completely pointless now, and I truly believe it's just part of my punishment for all the mistakes I've made.
Have you had previous episodes of depression like this one, or is this the first time you've felt this way for an extended period?

No, I've never really experienced anything like this before. I was doing just fine before my heart issues started, but now I've sunk into this deep darkness and despair. This is definitely the first time I've ever felt this way.
